title: Alcoholic
alt: Two-panel comic. A man turns the phrase ‘could be’ into ‘cold beer,’ then has a revelation and declares, ‘That’s it! I’m an alcoholic!’
description: A two-panel wordplay comic about turning ‘could be’ into ‘cold beer’ and reaching an unfortunate revelation.
transcript: Man, thinking: Could be… cold be… cold beer…
Man: That's it! I'm an alcoholic!

title: Douchebag
alt: Two-panel comic. A man celebrates winning an online chess game, then says, ‘Yeah, they should have stuck to medicine!’
description: A two-panel online-chess comic about beating a player named Dr.MateMD and drawing a smug conclusion.
transcript: The chess screen shows Dr.MateMD versus pawgniid and says: You won.
Man: Yeah, they should have stuck to medicine!

title: Fool
alt: A tired-looking man wonders, ‘Why?? Why can’t I find the energy?’ while vaping from a device labeled ‘Juulfool.’
description: A tired man wonders why he cannot find any energy while vaping from a device labeled Juulfool.
transcript: Man, thinking: Why?? Why can't I find the energy?
The vaping device is labeled: Juulfool.

title: Artist
alt: A comic artist condemns AI-generated art, briefly imagines using it to finish work and spend time with family, dismisses the idea as bullshit, then resumes drawing alone late at night.
description: A comic artist condemns AI-generated art, imagines using it to finish work and spend time with family, then returns to drawing alone.
transcript: Artist: AI-generated art is destroying my livelihood!!
Artist, thinking: But wait… am I wrong?
Computer prompt: Draw knight entering town in style of photo. Generate.
Artist, thinking: Nah never mind—that's bullshit!
caption: Turns out the process described in the thought bubble doesn't work as reliably as I thought. I'm not going to remove this comic because my mistake is funny. In my defense, an LLM *did* make comic #3 based on the style of #2.

title: Moderators
alt: Four-panel comic. A post arguing about freelance-platform fees is automatically removed for containing an external link. The author politely messages the moderators, then is temporarily banned for self-promotion.
description: A comic about an automatically removed Reddit post, a polite appeal to moderators, and a five-day ban for self-promotion.
transcript: Post: Freelance platforms like Fiverr and Upwork might be bad for the economy because of their fees. A privately owned, publicly owned, nonprofit, taxpayer-funded, or otherwise public-interest alternative could provide the same marketplace function without taking a cut from transactions. But I defer to the expert consensus on this one.
Notice: Post removed automatically. Reason: external links can be self-promotion.
Message to r/Fiverr Mods: I hope you're having a great day! Please allow the post. It doesn't count as self-promotion.
A day or two later: You have been temporarily banned from participating in r/Fiverr for 5 days. Note from the moderators: Rule 1: No self-promotion.

title: Executive
alt: A pharmaceutical chemist earning $78,000 says it is okay that India copied a drug formula because people need it. A pharmaceutical executive earning $363,000 angrily protests the cost of research and development and India's lack of respect for intellectual property. A closing line says the executive believes his higher pay reflects higher aptitude, a larger skillset, and a properly oriented moral compass.
description: A pharmaceutical chemist and executive take opposing positions on drug formulas, intellectual property, research costs, and access to medicine.
transcript: Pharmaceutical chemist — $78,000/year: I think it's okay that India copied the formula. Their people need—
Pharmaceutical executive — $363,000/year: Do you have any idea how much R&D costs?! India has no respect for innovation or intellectual property!!
The pharmaceutical executive believes his higher pay reflects higher aptitude, a larger skillset, and a properly oriented moral compass.
